_about: Sir William Smith (1813-1893), lexicographer and editor of the classical dictionaries. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot, 2026-10-10): A Smaller History of Greece, A Smaller History of Rome (revised by Eugene Lawrence) and A Smaller Dictionary of Greek and Roman Antiquities, clean Gutenberg. Also the full Dictionaries as raw IA OCR: Antiquities (first edition, 1842), Biography and Mythology (Boston, 1870; vols. I-II, vol. III wanted) and Geography (Boston: vol. I 1854, vol. II 1870). These are many-author reference works under Smith's editorship; the contributors are listed in each volume. No uids minted.
